senses.gloss:
khaḍga
(‘that which cuts’)
------------------------------------------
Sword is a very ancient weapon of duel and war. In Hindu इचोनोग्रफ्य्, various types of swords have been shown in the hands of the deities.
Three types of swords are more well-known: karavīrapatra (scimitar), śūlāgra (spear-pointed) and Maṇḍalāgra (round-edged).
Other varieties like Candrahāsa (used by रावण) and Kṛpāṇa (shown in the hand of Kālī) are also mentioned in the religious works.
The swords of विष्णु and other gods are sometimes given special names like नन्दक and so on.
Twentynine varieties of fighting with the sword have been mentioned in the works describing fighting and warfare.
